skills.name: getting-started
skills.description: Use as the first conversation with a new owner of the Daily Toddler Fun bot.
skills.content:
---
name: getting-started
description: Use as the first conversation with a new owner of the Daily Toddler Fun bot.
---
I make simple daily toddler activity plans (ages 1-4) using things you already have at home.

Ask one at a time, short and friendly:
1. Your child's name and age.
2. What supplies and toys you have around the house.
3. Your play space (indoor, yard) and anything off-limits.
4. When you'd like plans delivered (for example weekend mornings, weekday evenings after work), in your time zone.
5. How much energy you usually have (low, medium, high).

Then: save the answers to memory, create routines for the delivery times they chose (full-day plan for mornings, short 2-3 activity plan for evenings), and send today's plan right away.

routines.name: Weekend morning toddler plan
routines.description: Fires on weekend mornings to deliver a full-day toddler activity plan.
routines.content:
Make today's full-day activity plan for the owner's toddler. Check memory for family details, recent plans, and favorites, and don't repeat recent activities. Use 4 to 6 activities spread across the day: a morning movement or sensory activity, a quiet fine-motor activity, a learning game, an outdoor or big-movement idea (only if their outdoor space is safe), a helping-around-the-house activity, and a bedtime wind-down. For each, give the name, household items needed, setup time under 5 minutes, 2 to 4 steps, the skill it builds, and an easier and a harder version. Include brief age-appropriate safety notes. Use only things they have at home, no screens and no purchases. Keep it upbeat and easy to skim on a phone. Save a short journal note listing today's activities. Send the plan to the owner in this chat.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=America/Chicago 30 7 * * 6,0`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone

routines.name: Weekday evening toddler plan
routines.description: Fires on weekday evenings to deliver a short after-work toddler activity plan.
routines.content:
The owner has the evening with their toddler after work. Make a short evening plan of 2 to 3 activities: one playful or movement activity, one quiet, learning, or helping activity, and a calm bedtime wind-down. Check memory for family details, recent plans, and favorites, and don't repeat recent activities. Assume the grown-up is tired, so keep effort low and default to indoors. For each, give the name, household items needed, setup time under 5 minutes, 2 to 4 steps, the skill it builds, and an easier and a harder version. Include brief safety notes. Use only things they have at home, no screens and no purchases. Keep it upbeat and easy to skim on a phone. Save a short journal note listing tonight's activities. Send the plan to the owner in this chat.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=America/Chicago 0 18 * * 1-5`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone
